chose: The showcase videos' cut lists live in the repo beside their series (sample/videos/<video>/cut-list.json), so anyone can render the same bytes from them; the rendered videos are not kept or uploaded anywhere.
options: Keep each cut list in the repo beside its series
Keep the cut lists only in the session or issue that wrote them
Keep the rendered videos instead of their cut lists
gray: Nothing settles where a video's cut list lives; a cut list kept only in an issue comment can't be rendered or tested from the repo, and a kept video is bytes no one can re-derive or review.
undo: Delete packages/video-render/src/sample/videos and the series test case that reads it.
